description: This is a Java class named HttpClient that provides functionality for sending HTTP GET and POST requests, managing connections, handling headers and parameters, and reading responses. It encapsulates HTTP communication logic including SSL considerations, request headers, authentication, and connection settings.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A utility class for performing HTTP GET and POST requests, managing request headers, parameters, SSL options, response reading, and connection management. It supports setting timeouts, headers, authentication, and handling SSL certificates, providing a flexible API for HTTP communication.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the configured URL and returns the response as a String.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns the response as an InputStream.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the configured URL with optional raw stream data, returning the response as a String.

methods.name: postStream
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request and returns the response as an InputStream.

methods.name: getResponseHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified response header field.

methods.name: getResponseHeaderFieldKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key of the nth response header field.

methods.name: getResponseHeaderField
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the nth response header field.

methods.name: getResponseContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the response as an Object.

methods.name: getResponseContentType
methods.description: Returns the Content-Type of the response.

methods.name: getResponseContentLength
methods.description: Returns the Content-Length of the response.

methods.name: getResponseContentEncoding
methods.description: Returns the Content-Encoding of the response.

methods.name: getResponseCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response status code.

methods.name: sendHttpRequest
methods.description: Handles sending of the HTTP request based on the specified method ('get' or 'post') and processes the response stream into a String.

methods.name: sendHttpRequestStream
methods.description: Handles sending of the HTTP request and returns the raw InputStream of the response.

methods.name: getUrlContent
methods.description: Static method to fetch the entire content of the URL as a String.

methods.name: checkHttpRequest
methods.description: Static method to perform a GET request to check the URL's response code.
